property_summary: For any successful payable fallback call sending exactly 10 ether when block.timestamp > previous pastBlockTime, the reference sets pastBlockTime to the current block.timestamp (strictly increasing), whereas the mutant sets it to block.number and therefore can leave pastBlockTime not equal to the current block.timestamp for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the assignment to set pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp, altering the stored value exposed by the public getter.
